results.description: Available attribute keys matching the filters.

count.description: Total attribute keys matched (not paginated).

dateRange.description: Date range for the count. Defaults to last hour.

searchTerm.description: Full-text search term to filter log bodies.

date_from.description: Bucket start as ISO 8601 timestamp. Inclusive lower bound. Pass back as `dateRange.date_from` to drill in.

date_to.description: Bucket end as ISO 8601 timestamp. Exclusive upper bound. Pass back as `dateRange.date_to` to drill in.

count.description: Log entries matching the filters within this bucket.

dateRange.description: Window to bucket. Defaults to last hour. Use a bucket's date_from/date_to from a prior response to recursively narrow into a sub-range.

targetBuckets.description: Approximate number of buckets to return. The bucket interval is picked adaptively from a fixed list (1/5/10s, 1/2/5/10/15/30/60/120/240/360/720/1440m) to land near this target. Defaults to 10, capped at 100.

severityLevels.description: Filter by log severity levels. Applied before bucketing.

serviceNames.description: Filter by service names. Applied before bucketing.

searchTerm.description: Full-text search across log bodies. Applied before bucketing.

filterGroup.description: Property filters applied before bucketing. Same shape as `query-logs`.

query.description: The bucketed-count query to execute.

ranges.description: Buckets ordered by `date_from` ascending. Empty buckets are omitted — infer gaps by comparing each bucket's `date_to` to the next bucket's `date_from`.

interval.description: Short-form duration of the chosen bucket width (e.g. "1h", "5m", "30s", "1d"). Informational only — use each bucket's `date_from`/`date_to` for follow-up queries.

query.description: The count query to execute.

count.description: Number of log entries matching the filters.

facetField.description:
Top-level column to facet on. Provide exactly one of facetField, facetResourceAttribute or facetAttribute. Its own filter is excluded so counts reflect the other active filters.

* `severity_text` - severity_text
* `service_name` - service_name

facetResourceAttribute.description: Resource attribute key to facet on (e.g. 'k8s.namespace.name'). Provide exactly one of facetField, facetResourceAttribute or facetAttribute. Its own log_resource_attribute filter is excluded so counts reflect the other active filters.

facetAttribute.description: Log attribute key to facet on (e.g. 'log.iostream'). Provide exactly one of facetField, facetResourceAttribute or facetAttribute. Counts honour severity, service and resource-attribute filters, but not body search, other log-attribute filters, or this facet's own filter.

dateRange.description: Date range. Defaults to last hour.

severityLevels.description: Filter by log severity levels (ignored when faceting on severity_text).

serviceNames.description: Filter by service names (ignored when faceting on service_name).

searchTerm.description: Full-text search term to filter log bodies.

facetSearch.description: Type-ahead filter over the faceted field's own values (case-insensitive substring match). Distinct from searchTerm, which searches log bodies.

personId.description: Scope counts to one person (UUID or numeric ID). Expanded server-side to the person's distinct IDs and matched against the team's configured distinct-id log attribute keys.

sessionId.description: Scope counts to one session ID. Matched server-side against the team's configured session-id log attribute keys plus the built-in conventions, in both log attributes and resource attributes.

query.description: The facet values query to execute.

results.description: Facet values with cross-filtered counts, ordered by count descending.

dateRange.description: Date range to aggregate over. Defaults to last hour.

severityLevels.description: Filter by log severity levels before grouping.

serviceNames.description: Restrict grouping to these service names.

searchTerm.description: Full-text search term to filter log bodies before grouping.

filterGroup.description: Property filters applied before grouping. Same shape as the query-logs endpoint.

groupBy.description: The key to group logs by — an attribute key (e.g. "session_id", "service.name") or, when groupBySource is "column", one of the top-level log fields: "severity_level", "trace_id", "span_id". Ignored when groupBys is provided.

groupBySource.description:
Where the grouping key lives: "log" for log-level attributes, "resource" for resource-level attributes, "column" for top-level log fields. Ignored when groupBys is provided.

* `log` - log
* `resource` - resource
* `column` - column

groupBys.description: Ordered group-by dimensions to combine (a group is one combination of per-dimension values), up to 4. Takes precedence over groupBy/groupBySource; one of the two must be provided.

orderGroupsBy.description:
Aggregate to rank groups by (descending): "log_count" for the noisiest groups, "error_count" for the most failing, "last_seen" for the most recent.

* `log_count` - log_count
* `error_count` - error_count
* `last_seen` - last_seen

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return (top-N by orderGroupsBy). Defaults to 100.

personId.description: Scope grouping to one person (UUID or numeric ID). Expanded server-side to the person's distinct IDs and matched against the team's configured distinct-id log attribute keys.

sessionId.description: Scope grouping to one session ID. Matched server-side against the team's configured session-id log attribute keys plus the built-in conventions, in both log attributes and resource attributes.

key.description: The key this dimension groups by — an attribute key (e.g. "session_id", "service.name") or, when source is "column", one of the top-level log fields: "severity_level", "trace_id", "span_id".

source.description:
Where this dimension's key lives: "log" for log-level attributes, "resource" for resource-level attributes, "column" for top-level log fields.

* `log` - log
* `resource` - resource
* `column` - column

value.description: The first dimension's grouped value. Kept for single-dimension callers; prefer `values`.

values.description: This group's values, one per requested dimension, in request order.

log_count.description: Number of matching logs in this group.

error_count.description: Number of matching logs in this group at severity "error" or "fatal".

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent matching log in this group.

query.description: The group-by query to execute.

groups.description: Top groups ordered by the requested aggregate, descending. Capped at `limit`.

total_groups.description: Total distinct group values matching the filters, before the top-N cap.

total_logs.description: Total matching logs across all groups (rows without the grouping key are excluded).

truncated.description: True when more groups matched than were returned (total_groups > groups length).

source.description:
Attribute map the key lives in, in the group-by endpoint's vocabulary: "log" or "resource".

* `log` - log
* `resource` - resource
* `column` - column

key.description: The attribute key that carries the ID on most matching logs.

query.description: The impact query to execute. Takes the same filters as the count query.

total.description: Number of log entries matching the filters.

logsWithSessionId.description: How many of the matching logs carry a session ID under the team's configured or conventional attribute keys.

sessions.description: Estimated number of unique session IDs across the matching logs (HyperLogLog, about 1-2% error).

logsWithDistinctId.description: How many of the matching logs carry a person distinct ID under the team's configured or conventional attribute keys.

users.description: Estimated number of unique distinct IDs across the matching logs (HyperLogLog, about 1-2% error).

topSessions.description: Top session IDs on the matching logs, ordered by log count descending (topK, at most 5).

topUsers.description: Top person distinct IDs on the matching logs, ordered by log count descending (topK, at most 5).

sessionGroupKey.description: The dimension that carries the session ID on most matching logs. Group by this dimension to drill into the sessions behind the counts. Null when no matching log carries a session ID.

personGroupKey.description: The dimension that carries the person distinct ID on most matching logs. Group by this dimension to drill into the users behind the counts. Null when no matching log carries a distinct ID.

value.description: The session ID or person distinct ID.

count.description: Approximate number of matching logs that carry this value (topK estimate).

dateRange.description: Date range to mine patterns from. Defaults to last hour.

severityLevels.description: Filter by log severity levels before mining.

serviceNames.description: Restrict mining to these service names.

searchTerm.description: Full-text search term to filter log bodies before mining.

filterGroup.description: Property filters applied before mining. Same shape as the query-logs endpoint.

personId.description: Scope mining to one person (UUID or numeric ID). Expanded server-side to the person's distinct IDs and matched against the team's configured distinct-id log attribute keys.

sessionId.description: Scope mining to one session ID. Matched server-side against the team's configured session-id log attribute keys plus the built-in conventions, in both log attributes and resource attributes.

query.description: The patterns query for the current (foreground) window: date range plus any severity/service/search/property filters. The same filters are applied to the baseline window.

baselineDateRange.description: Baseline window to compare against. Omit to default to the current window shifted back exactly one week, which absorbs daily and weekly log-volume cycles. Pass an explicit range to compare against a specific period, e.g. pre-deploy or pre-incident.

entries.description: Classified diff entries, most interesting first: "new" (by estimated count), then "rate_shift" (by shift magnitude), then "gone", then "unchanged". A pattern in the baseline is matched to the current window by literal-content fingerprint, so a placeholder widening between runs does not read as one pattern vanishing and another appearing.

current.description: Mining metadata for the current window.

baseline.description: Mining metadata for the baseline window. Check `total_count` before trusting a wall of "new" entries: an empty or tiny baseline (e.g. logging only started this week) makes everything look new.

source.description:
Whether counts come from stored-pattern aggregation or body masking and Drain3 mining.

* `stored_patterns` - stored_patterns
* `body_mining` - body_mining

pattern_version.description: Stored pattern version used. Null for body mining.

fallback_reason.description:
Why body mining was used. Null for stored-pattern aggregation.

* `flag_disabled` - flag_disabled
* `insufficient_version_coverage` - insufficient_version_coverage
* `empty_window` - empty_window
* `comparison` - comparison

pattern_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of all matching rows with a nonempty pattern at the selected version. Null for body mining.

represented_count.description: Exact rows represented by the returned stored-pattern groups. Null for body mining.

remainder_count.description: Matching rows outside returned groups, including other versions, unstamped rows and the long tail. Null for body mining.

scanned_count.description: Log rows fed to the miner for this window (sample size).

total_count.description: Total log rows matching the filters in this window.

sampled.description: True when this window's counts are extrapolated from a sample rather than exact.

sample_coverage_pct.description: Share of this window's rows eligible for sampling (0-100); below 100 the scan was time-slice bounded.

date_from.description: Resolved window start (ISO 8601, inclusive).

query.description: The patterns query to execute.

source.description:
Whether counts come from stored-pattern aggregation or body masking and Drain3 mining.

* `stored_patterns` - stored_patterns
* `body_mining` - body_mining

pattern_version.description: Stored pattern version used. Null for body mining.

fallback_reason.description:
Why body mining was used. Null for stored-pattern aggregation.

* `flag_disabled` - flag_disabled
* `insufficient_version_coverage` - insufficient_version_coverage
* `empty_window` - empty_window
* `comparison` - comparison

pattern_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of all matching rows with a nonempty pattern at the selected version. Null for body mining.

represented_count.description: Exact rows represented by the returned stored-pattern groups. Null for body mining.

remainder_count.description: Matching rows outside returned groups, including other versions, unstamped rows and the long tail. Null for body mining.

patterns.description: Pattern groups ordered by count. Stored-pattern counts are exact; body-mining counts describe the sample.

scanned_count.description: Rows scanned: the sample size for body mining, or the full matching count for stored-pattern aggregation.

total_count.description: Total log rows matching the filters in the window, before sampling. Use with `scanned_count` to scale per-pattern counts when `sampled` is true.

sampled.description: True when the window held more rows than the sample cap, so patterns were mined from a deterministic, evenly-distributed sample rather than every matching row.

sample_coverage_pct.description: Share of the window's log rows that were eligible for sampling (0–100). Below 100, the scan was bounded to evenly-spaced time slices across the window to keep the query within its execution budget; rows outside the slices could not appear in the sample.

sparkline_buckets.description: Time buckets that every pattern's `sparkline` aligns to. When the scan was bounded to time slices, the buckets are the slices themselves (evenly spaced, gaps between them were never eligible for sampling); otherwise they divide the window uniformly.

dateRange.description: Date range for the query. Defaults to last hour.

orderBy.description:
Order results by timestamp.

* `latest` - latest
* `earliest` - earliest

searchTerm.description: Full-text search term to filter log bodies.

limit.description: Max results (1-1000).

excludeAttributes.description: Omit the per-log attributes and resource_attributes maps from results to keep payloads compact. Defaults to false.

customColumns.description: Custom column expressions evaluated per log row. Each entry is either a source-prefixed shorthand (`attributes.<key>`, `resource_attributes.<key>`, `body.<json.path>`) or a scalar HogQL expression (`upper(level)`, `coalesce(attributes['a'], attributes['b'])`). Aggregations and subqueries are rejected. Values come back on each result row keyed by the aliases echoed in the response `columns` field.

personId.description: Scope results to one person (UUID or numeric ID). Expanded server-side to the person's distinct IDs and matched against the team's configured distinct-id log attribute keys.

sessionId.description: Scope results to one session ID. Matched server-side against the team's configured session-id log attribute keys plus the built-in conventions, in both log attributes and resource attributes.

query.description: The logs query to execute.
The parsed query that was executed, echoed back for confirmation.

results.description: Log entries matching the query.

hasMore.description: True if more results exist beyond this page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `after` in the next request to fetch the next page. Null when hasMore is false.

maxExportableLogs.description: Maximum number of rows the `export` endpoint will produce — informational.

columns.description: Aliases for the requested `customColumns`, in request order. Each result row carries its custom column values under these keys. Null when no custom columns were requested.

service_name.description: Service name, or "(no value)" / "(no service)" placeholder for unset entries.

log_count.description: Total log entries from this service in the window.

error_count.description: Count of logs at severity "error" or "fatal".

error_rate.description: Pre-computed error_count / log_count, rounded to 4 decimals. Useful for ranking noisy services.

volume_share_pct.description: Share of total log volume in the window for this service (0–100).

severity_breakdown.description: Counts by coarse severity bucket (debug, info, warn, error+fatal).

active_rules.description: Enabled sampling rules whose scope includes this service.

dateRange.description: Date range for the services aggregation. Defaults to last hour.

serviceNames.description: Restrict the aggregation to these service names.

searchTerm.description: Full-text search term to filter log bodies.

serviceNameSearch.description: Case-insensitive substring match on service name, applied before aggregation. Use to reach services beyond the response cap.

query.description: The services aggregation query to execute.

services.description: Per-service aggregates, ordered by log_count descending. Capped at 10000 services.

sparkline.description: Time-bucketed counts broken down by service, for plotting volume over time. Covers only the top 25 services in this response; re-request with `serviceNames` to get sparklines for specific services.

total_services.description: True distinct service count for the window and filters, unaffected by the 10000-service cap on `services`. Greater than the length of `services` when the response is truncated.

summary.description: Roll-up stats for the Services tab header.

top_services_count.description: Number of top services included in the volume_share aggregate (up to 5).

top_services_volume_share_pct.description: Combined volume share (percent) of the top services by log_count.

dateRange.description: Date range for the sparkline. Defaults to last hour.

searchTerm.description: Full-text search term to filter log bodies.

sparklineBreakdownBy.description:
Break down sparkline by "severity" (default) or "service".

* `severity` - severity
* `service` - service

sparklineRankBy.description:
Rank breakdown values by "count" (default) or "bytes" before collapsing the tail into "other".

* `count` - count
* `bytes` - bytes

personId.description: Scope results to one person (UUID or numeric ID). Expanded server-side to the person's distinct IDs and matched against the team's configured distinct-id log attribute keys.

sessionId.description: Scope results to one session ID. Matched server-side against the team's configured session-id log attribute keys plus the built-in conventions, in both log attributes and resource attributes.

severity.description: Severity label when sparklineBreakdownBy="severity". Present only for severity-broken-down sparklines.

service.description: Service name when sparklineBreakdownBy="service". Present only for service-broken-down sparklines.

bytes_uncompressed.description: Sum of uncompressed bytes for the bucket.

query.description: The sparkline query to execute.

results.description: Time-bucketed log counts. Each bucket carries either `severity` or `service` depending on breakdown.
Distinct values observed for the requested attribute.

refreshing.description: Always false — reserved for future cached-value refresh signalling.

anomalyFrom.description: Start of the suspicious window (inclusive). ISO 8601 — e.g. when the alert fired or the graph started looking wrong.

anomalyTo.description: End of the suspicious window (exclusive). Defaults to now.

baselineFrom.description: Start of the healthy comparison window. Defaults to one anomaly-window-length before baselineTo.

baselineTo.description: End of the healthy comparison window. Defaults to anomalyFrom. Must not extend past anomalyFrom.

aggregation.description:
Aggregation to characterize. Omit to auto-pick from the metric's OTel type (counter -> rate, gauge -> avg, histogram -> histogram_quantile 0.95).

* `sum` - sum
* `avg` - avg
* `count` - count
* `min` - min
* `max` - max
* `p95` - p95
* `rate` - rate
* `increase` - increase
* `histogram_quantile` - histogram_quantile

filters.description: Label predicates narrowing which series are characterized.

candidateKeys.description: Label keys to drill into when finding which label values moved. Omit to auto-discover the most common keys on this metric (plus service_name). Max 4 are used.

key.description: Label key that was drilled into.

label.description: Label value this row describes.

baseline_value.description: Mean value over the baseline window for this label value.

anomaly_value.description: Mean value over the anomaly window for this label value.

change_ratio.description: anomaly_value / baseline_value. A zero baseline yields the anomaly value itself (new traffic).

interval.description: Bucket size of the analysis grid.

baseline_stddev.description: Population stddev over the baseline window.

anomaly_peak.description: Maximum bucket value in the anomaly window.

change_ratio.description: anomaly_mean / baseline_mean. A zero baseline yields anomaly_mean itself.

direction.description:
Which way the metric moved versus the baseline.

* `up` - up
* `down` - down
* `flat` - flat

onset_time.description: First bucket clearly outside the baseline range (3 stddevs or 50% relative change), or null if no clear onset.

top_movers.description: Label values whose behavior changed the most between windows, largest change first. Empty when nothing moved or the metric has no labels.

series.description: The metric across baseline + anomaly windows on one grid, for plotting or further inspection.

query.description: The anomaly characterization to run.

aggregation.description:
Aggregation applied per time bucket, always across series rather than across raw samples. 'sum', 'avg', 'min', 'max' and 'p95' reduce each series to its last sample in the bucket and then combine those, so the result does not scale with the scrape rate; 'count' is the number of series that reported. 'rate' (per-second) and 'increase' are counter-aware: per-series deltas with Prometheus counter-reset handling, temporality-aware (delta-temporality samples count as-is). 'histogram_quantile' interpolates from OTel histogram buckets and requires 'quantile'.

* `sum` - sum
* `avg` - avg
* `count` - count
* `min` - min
* `max` - max
* `p95` - p95
* `rate` - rate
* `increase` - increase
* `histogram_quantile` - histogram_quantile

_ReviewOutputSummary.description:
Allowlisted, non-sensitive slice of ``ReviewRun.output``.

The raw ``output`` blob also holds the reviewer's stdout, the full PR payload, changed-file patches,
and default-branch policy file contents, none of which the API returns. The reviewer's reasoning,
the text stamphog posts on GitHub, is parsed out of the stdout and returned as ``reasoning``.

date_to.description: End of the window. Same format as date_from. Omit or null for "now".

_Span.description:
One span row as the query and trace actions return it.

The runner assembles these from HogQL result columns by position, so the key set is fixed even
though the values come from a query. `trace_start` and `trace_duration` are the sort keys the
trace list orders on, carried in the row rather than recomputed by the caller.

parent_span_id.description: Parent span's ID. Empty for a root span.

name.description: Span name, which is the operation it represents.

kind.description: OpenTelemetry span kind.

status_code.description: OpenTelemetry status code: 0 unset, 1 ok, 2 error.

timestamp.description: When the span started.

is_root_span.description: Whether the span has no parent in the trace.

matched_filter.description: 1 when this span matched the request's filters, 0 when it is included as context. The query selects it as an expression, so it arrives as a number rather than a boolean.

trace_start.description: Start of the whole trace, for ordering traces by recency.

trace_duration.description: Duration of the whole trace in nanoseconds. Falls back to this span's duration.

attributes.description: Span attributes. Keys are whatever the instrumentation set.

resource_attributes.description: Resource attributes of the emitting service. Keys are whatever the instrumentation set.

_SpanTreeNode.description: One node of the aggregated call tree. Mirrors `SpanTreeNode` in posthog.schema.

name.description: Span name for this node.

parent_service.description: Parent node's service. Empty string at the root.

count.description: Spans aggregated into this node.

error_count.description: How many of them reported an error status.

calls_per_parent_invocation.description: Mean calls per parent invocation. Null at the root.

date_from.description: Inclusive UTC start of the spend window resolved from the request.

date_to.description: Exclusive UTC end of the spend window resolved from the request.

product.description: The `ai_product` filter applied to tool / model / trace breakdowns — echoes the request `product`.

total_cost_usd.description: Total LLM cost in USD across every `ai_product` for the user — independent of the `product` filter.

event_count.description: Total $ai_generation + $ai_embedding events captured across every product.

scoped_cost_usd.description: Total cost in USD for the product filter. Matches the cost summed across `by_tool` / `by_model` for the scoped slice.

scoped_event_count.description: Total $ai_generation + $ai_embedding events for the scoped slice.

url.description: Presigned URL to download the source map file. Use immediately; expires after one hour.

count.description: Number of spans attributed to this symbol in the period.

error_count.description: Spans whose OTel status is Error (status_code = 2).

sum_duration_nano.description: Total wall-clock span duration in the period, in nanoseconds (additive across spans).

p50_duration_nano.description: Median wall-clock span duration, in nanoseconds.

dateRange.description: Current period to aggregate over; the prior equal-length window is the comparison. Defaults to last 24h.

symbols.description: Optional symbol (function) line ranges, supplied by the client from its own AST/LSP. When given, each span is attributed to the smallest enclosing range (one row per symbol). When omitted (or an empty list), spans are aggregated per source line (one row per line); pass a single whole-file range for a file-level total.

query.description: The symbol-stats per-symbol aggregation query to execute.

results.description: One row per bucket, ordered by line ascending.

granularity.description:
Bucketing applied: 'line' when no symbols were supplied, 'symbol' otherwise.

* `line` - line
* `symbol` - symbol

count.description: Number of spans attributed to this symbol in the period.

error_count.description: Spans whose OTel status is Error (status_code = 2).

sum_duration_nano.description: Total wall-clock span duration in the period, in nanoseconds (additive across spans).

p50_duration_nano.description: Median wall-clock span duration, in nanoseconds.

busy_count.description: Spans in the period carrying an active/busy time attribute. 0 means busy_* are not meaningful.

line.description: Bucket anchor: the source line (line mode) or the symbol's startLine (symbol mode).

name.description: Echoed name from the requested symbol (symbol mode only).

end_line.description: endLine of the matched symbol's range (symbol mode only).

previous.description: The same metrics over the immediately-preceding equal-length period.

name.description: Opaque identifier (e.g. the function name) echoed back on the matching result row.

startLine.description: First line of the symbol's range, inclusive.

endLine.description: Last line of the symbol's range, inclusive.

x.description: Column position in the dashboard grid (0-indexed).

y.description: Row position in the dashboard grid (0-indexed).

w.description: Width in grid columns. The desktop grid is 12 columns wide.

sm.description: Layout for the standard (desktop) breakpoint. The grid is 12 columns wide.

items.description: Rows of spend by tool, ordered by cost descending.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist beyond the requested `limit`. Re-request with a larger `limit` to retrieve them.

tool.description: Individual tool name from `$ai_tools_called` (split on `,` since multi-tool generations store a comma-separated list). Null = pure text response with no tool call.

generation_count.description: Number of $ai_generation events whose tool list includes this tool.

Multi-tool generations contribute their full cost to every tool they invoked, so this sum can exceed `summary.scoped_cost_usd`. Prefer `share_of_scoped` for headline percentages — it's computed per row and doesn't require the totals to reconcile.

share_of_scoped.description: This tool's share of `summary.scoped_cost_usd`, expressed as a float in `[0, 1]`. Independent per row, so co-occurring tools can each show a substantial share — the headline number to present (e.g. `'Bash drove 47% of your spend'`).

avg_input_tokens.description: Average `$ai_input_tokens` across these generations — high values signal context bloat per call.

trace_id.description: `$ai_trace_id` of the session — opaque string scoped to the originating product. Format is not stable: most are UUIDs but some SDK wrappers emit JSON-shaped strings like `{"device_id":"...","session_id":"..."}`. Callers should treat this as an opaque identifier (URL-encode before linking to a trace view).

cost_usd.description: Total cost in USD for this trace.

started_at.description: Timestamp of the earliest event in this trace.

items.description: Rows of top traces by cost, ordered by cost descending.

name.description: Span name, which is the operation it represents.

kind.description: OpenTelemetry span kind.

status_code.description: OpenTelemetry status code: 0 unset, 1 ok, 2 error.

timestamp.description: When the span started.

is_root_span.description: Whether the span has no parent in the trace.

matched_filter.description: 1 when this span matched the request's filters, 0 when it is included as context. The query selects it as an expression, so it arrives as a number rather than a boolean.

trace_duration.description: Duration of the whole trace in nanoseconds. Falls back to this span's duration.

resource_attributes.description: Resource attributes of the emitting service. Keys are whatever the instrumentation set.

dateRange.description: Date range for the primary window. Defaults to last hour.

Keep this small to bound the response size — a high value on high-cardinality span names (e.g. untemplated URL paths) returns a very large payload.
